baseline.type: provisional historical estimate, NOT recalculated or earned by PR count

scopePolicy: Never remove or simplify capabilities; all registry groups, AI features, industry packs and long-term phases remain included
statusSemantics: acceptance_not_verified means unknown until real source, CI, deployment and customer UAT evidence is reviewed, not necessarily unimplemented
sharedAcceptance: Real end-to-end customer workflow and failure/retry paths verified
Online, Offline Windows and Hybrid behavior verified, or documented reason a surface is inapplicable
Multi-branch, roles/RLS, audit, backup/recovery and portability verified where applicable
Regression and security tests green at exact PR head and after merge
Customer-facing UAT and release/deployment evidence recorded, not inferred from CI

initiatives.title: First paying-customer onboarding and released Windows/Online/Hybrid acceptance
initiatives.criticalOutcome: Customer can install or sign in, enter real opening data, transact, print, backup/restore, update and request support without developer-only steps
initiatives.nextAction: First-customer setup workflow: validated reversible user+branch browser confirmations and optional v15-compatible backup snapshot field are implemented on a source branch. Verify PR exact-head and postmerge CI; then perform first paying-customer licensed Windows physical UAT (sales/stock/printing/backup/restore/update/support), record precise blockers, and separately authorize the signed installer. No UAT or commercial acceptance claimed.
